verdict.rationale: Formant documents a durable message queue that delivers requests to a device either immediately or the next time it comes online. That is its own capability for handling disconnected robots and recovering commands on reconnect. A guide to custom directories for agent data operations hints at on-device data handling, but nothing states that telemetry is buffered locally during an outage and backfilled afterward. missing for 10: explicit local telemetry/data buffering during cloud outages, documented upload backfill or ordering on reconnect, evidence that robot operation continues independently of cloud connectivity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
